selection_basis: Editorial incremental-coverage hypotheses across media types and protocols, deduplicated against individual native Media Intake connectors; not a traffic ranking, live accessibility audit, demonstrated search benefit, or permission statement.
notes: Historical domains are evidence only and must not be used as live request targets without separate review.
Jackett is already an existing generic Torznab integration; these site names are not preconfigured indexers.
Source-specific and work-specific rights remain separate, and no source receives automatic download approval.
Media Intake lacks a Music category; cross-media coverage must not pretend that music is directly supported.

candidates.name: AIO Search
candidates.identity_caveat: The historical directory and 2026 self-described interface reference the same aiosearch.com root domain, but shared domain spelling does not establish unchanged operators, working search-provider integrations, or continuity over intervening years.
candidates.coverage_hypothesis: Cross-category metasearch is a high-potential discovery complement, but the operator's listed provider categories are not proof of functioning connectors.
